description: This file defines classes and types related to test suite and test case management in a testing framework, including Suite and TestCase classes, with methods for serialization, cloning, and test hierarchy navigation.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: Base class for test suite and test case, holding common properties like title and flags.

classes.name: Suite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, containing nested suites and test cases, with methods for hierarchy management and serialization.

classes.name: TestCase
classes.description: Represents an individual test case, with properties for execution results, tags, and hierarchy navigation.

methods.name: titlePath
methods.description: Returns the full hierarchical path of titles leading to the suite or test case.

methods.name: allTests
methods.description: Recursively collects all test cases within the suite and nested suites.

methods.name: _serialize
methods.description: Serializes the suite or test case into a plain object for storage or transfer.

methods.name: _clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the suite or test case.

methods.name: _deepSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the entire suite hierarchy including nested suites and tests.

methods.name: _deepParse
methods.description: Parses serialized data to reconstruct the suite hierarchy.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Returns the associated project for the suite.

methods.name: _collectGrepTitlePath
methods.description: Collects titles and tags for grep matching.

methods.name: _collectTagTitlePath
methods.description: Collects titles and tags for tag extraction.

methods.name: _getOnlyItems
methods.description: Returns items marked as 'only' for focused testing.

methods.name: forEachTest
methods.description: Iterates over all tests in the suite hierarchy.

methods.name: _appendTestResult
methods.description: Adds a new test result entry to the test case.

methods.name: _grepBaseTitlePath
methods.description: Builds the base path of titles for grep matching.

methods.name: _grepTitleWithTags
methods.description: Returns the full title string including tags for grep matching.
